meta.units: quantities in 1000 t (published as integers); population in 1000 persons
meta.generation: Individual countries only (area codes < 5000, and the aggregate 351 'China' removed in favour of its four listed parts); individual items only (codes 2511-2899; 2501 Population and every code >= 2900, i.e. Grand Total, Vegetal/Animal Products and the item groups, removed). One sample per (country, item, year t) whose t and t-1 records both exist and whose t-1 population is published; elements not published within an existing record count as 0 (nil / not applicable), Domestic supply is present in every record. 222128 country-item-year records, 17298 without a t-1 record, 0 without t-1 population; 204830 samples over 178 areas x 98 items, targets 2011-2023. Stock Variation enters supply with a minus sign (addition to stocks), verified on the data. Because values are rounded to integer kt, the identities close only to within 2 kt in all but one record (Nepal, oranges, 2014: Processing 54 kt left out of Domestic supply). Labels are the published values.
meta.x_desc: year-(t-1) Production, Import, Export, Stock Variation, Domestic supply, Food, Feed, Seed, Losses, Processing, Other uses, Tourist consumption, Residuals of the same country-item (1000 t) and year-(t-1) total population (1000 persons) (14)
